items.title: Ray Conniff interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: Thank you very much, Monk, and gee lots of success.

ctx.x: Okay, well it was a great pleasure talking to you.

Thank you very much, Monk, and gee lots of success. I understand you’ve got about a hundred others, interviews like this in there. I hope some day I may get back to see you and may be able to see a little of them.
Please when you come out to view the fall colors in the east, maybe we can have you as a guest.
